description: doc-page-updater adds a section to a uk page whose headings have no ids: the new heading gets a unique {/* #id */}, and the existing headings stay as they were.
setup:
cat > docs/.sources/change-brief-retry-schedule.md <<'EOF'
# Change brief — retry schedule

## Page
docs/webhooks/webhooks.md

## What changed
- A new section describes the retry schedule: the system retries after 1, 5 and 30 minutes. — source: release notes 2026-10-01

## Where in the page
A new section after «Повторні спроби».

## Do not touch
- The sections «Налаштування вебхука» and «Повторні спроби».
EOF
git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'
prompt: use doc-page-updater with page `docs/webhooks/webhooks.md` and brief `docs/.sources/change-brief-retry-schedule.md`

assertions.name: new heading has its id, old ones untouched
a heading with an id was added
